lines.text: Our delivery robot bumps into boxes. Its distance sensor is broken. Can you replace it and program a safe stopping rule?
lines.voice_description: An original adult female voice with a bright warm middle-high register, clear American English, friendly conversational energy and crisp pronunciation. A welcoming practical workshop mentor.
lines.normalization: Target -20 dBFS RMS, constrained to -1 dBFS peak

lines.text: A missing echo is not proof that the path is clear. Get the HC-SR04 replacement from the store, then we will test the repair together.
lines.voice_description: An original adult female voice with a bright warm middle-high register, clear American English, friendly conversational energy and crisp pronunciation. A welcoming practical workshop mentor.
lines.normalization: Target -20 dBFS RMS, constrained to -1 dBFS peak

lines.text: The robot can deliver safely again. Your reward is saved. You can still experiment with the tests, but rewards only happen once.
lines.voice_description: An original adult female voice with a bright warm middle-high register, clear American English, friendly conversational energy and crisp pronunciation. A welcoming practical workshop mentor.
lines.normalization: Target -20 dBFS RMS, constrained to -1 dBFS peak

lines.text: Your sensor is fitted in this simulation. Return true to stop when distance is below 20 centimetres OR when no echo arrives, represented by undefined. At 20 centimetres and above, return false.
lines.voice_description: An original adult female voice with a bright warm middle-high register, clear American English, friendly conversational energy and crisp pronunciation. A welcoming practical workshop mentor.
lines.normalization: Target -20 dBFS RMS, constrained to -1 dBFS peak

lines.text: An ultrasonic sensor sends a sound pulse and times its echo. The HC-SR04 is a 5-volt part. Check the controller voltage before connecting it.
lines.voice_description: An original adult male voice with a rich medium-low register, relaxed friendly American English, a lightly textured timbre and clear unhurried articulation. A helpful neighborhood shopkeeper.
lines.normalization: Target -20 dBFS RMS, constrained to -1 dBFS peak

lines.text: We just got an LED and resistor kit. You can build a real status-light circuit in your lab. Later shelves will introduce motor drivers, Jetsons, and computer memory.
lines.voice_description: An original adult male voice with a rich medium-low register, relaxed friendly American English, a lightly textured timbre and clear unhurried articulation. A helpful neighborhood shopkeeper.
lines.normalization: Target -20 dBFS RMS, constrained to -1 dBFS peak

lines.text: This is your space to build. Help Iris repair the robot first, then we can use your earnings to make a status light.
lines.voice_description: An original adult female voice with a smooth low alto register, precise British English articulation, measured deliberate pacing and calm composed confidence. A patient laboratory instructor.
lines.normalization: Target -20 dBFS RMS, constrained to -1 dBFS peak

lines.text: Let's light up the lab with a red LED. The newly unlocked store shelf has an LED and resistor kit. Bring one here to begin.
lines.voice_description: An original adult female voice with a smooth low alto register, precise British English articulation, measured deliberate pacing and calm composed confidence. A patient laboratory instructor.
lines.normalization: Target -20 dBFS RMS, constrained to -1 dBFS peak

lines.text: Two complete jobs! You have practiced conditions, fault handling, testing, and resistor selection. This is the end of the current prototype, not the whole planned game.

lines.text: Our example uses a regulated 5-volt supply, a red LED with an assumed 2-volt drop, and a 15-milliamp target. Work out a series resistor before switching it on.

lines.text: All five tests passed. Robot repaired! Your lab project is unlocked.
